title: Device
description: One physical device as a Kubernetes resource, at the storage version of the CRD the project's chart installs.

name.description: Resource name, from the object metadata.

namespace.description: Namespace of the resource. Carried as an ordinary field in the interface message, rather than inside metadata.

device-model-ref.description: Local reference to the device model this instance is of. Wire key: deviceModelRef.

node-name.description: Node whose mapper reaches this device. The whole of the model's notion of where a device is. Wire key: nodeName.

properties.description: One entry per property of the model this instance overrides or configures.

name.description: Property name, as declared on the model.

desired.description: The value an operator wants. Nothing checks it against the type the model declares.

visitors.description: How this instance's property is reached, overriding the model's.

report-cycle.description: How often the mapper reports the value. Wire key: reportCycle.

collect-cycle.description: How often the mapper reads the device. Wire key: collectCycle.

report-to-cloud.description: Whether readings travel up the cloud-edge channel at all. Wire key: reportToCloud.

push-method.description: Where else the readings go. Wire key: pushMethod.

methods.description: Named groups of properties a caller may act on together.

state-report.description: Whether and how often the device's own online state is reported upward. Wire key: stateReport.
